notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.0 - Vibe becomes a drum designer. NEW: Eclipse Vibe KIT / SLOT model - build MANY custom drums. Vibe is no longer a fixed 10-drum kit: the kit is now a list of slots (up to 16), and each slot is an instrument built from a synthesis ENGINE (808, Kick, Snare, Clap, Snap, Hat, Rim, Tom) with its own params, name, MIDI note and level/pan. Want five different snares and three kicks? Add them. The pad grid ends with a "+ ADD" pad (pick an engine to spawn a slot); right-click any pad to rename it, change its engine, set its MIDI note, or delete it; select a pad and the knob panel shows that slot's engine params. Vibe opens with the classic 10-drum default kit so existing sounds are unchanged, the KEYS keyboard and presets still work, and saved projects store your custom kit. Still 4 synths (Prism, Alloy, Dusk, Vibe) + 25 FX bundled, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), macOS 12+.
